# deps: tools: up octosql to v0.8.0

Pin `octosql` at v0.8.0 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-329]] (v0.7.4). OctoSQL is the SQL-over-anything CLI ([[DOT-96]]); the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin — for OctoSQL with the extra risk of its `replace` directives ([[DOT-311]]). The release notes are the [v0.8.0 tag](https://github.com/cube2222/octosql/releases/tag/v0.8.0).
